What TMB Brows does

A particular combination, not a particular trick

TMB Brows does not claim to be the fastest or most secure browser. It is one app for the web, media, documents and a few everyday tools.

Tabs & Incognito

Several tabs that come back after you close the app; private tabs that keep nothing. Bookmarks and history stay on the phone.

Ad & tracker blocking

Blocks many common ad services and known trackers, plus YouTube's own in-page ads while the blocker is on. Allow ads per site if you want.

Smart Back

When a site bounces you through automatic redirects, a bar offers "Back to <site>" — the page you actually chose. Nothing is saved.

Media that keeps going

Background play with lock-screen controls, Picture-in-Picture, and Fit / Fill / Stretch on web video.

Nine tools, one app

Video Player, Audio Player, Image Viewer, PDF Reader, QR Tools, File Converter, File Share Hub, Advanced Compass and Steps.

Profiles

Up to 8 local profiles, or a Google-account label, each with its own website sign-ins. "Work" and "Personal" never mix.

Works offline too

Opens with no internet, shows an Offline bar, and the local tools keep working.

Themes & home page

Light, dark or follow the phone; a logo, search box and shortcut tiles you choose.

Built-in Tools

Nine tools that live inside the same app

Files you download open straight in the matching tool — an MP3 in the Audio Player, a PDF in the PDF Reader, and so on.

ADVANCED COMPASS

Level, Compass and Magnetic — sensors only

Three tabs using only the phone's own sensors, with no permission, no location and no network.

  • Compass: magnetic north, with Hold and calibration help
  • Level: a bubble level with Set Zero
  • Magnetic: the phone's magnetometer reading in microtesla — plainly not a metal, camera or radiation detector
FILE SHARE HUB

Find a file, hand it to the share sheet

Not a file manager — no copy, move, delete or rename. Just a quick way to find files and share them.

  • Categories: ALL, VIDEO, AUDIO, IMAGES, PDF, OTHER
  • Folders view, search, multi-select up to 100 files
  • A recent-files strip for quick access
QR TOOLS & FILE CONVERTER

Scan, create, convert — no separate app

QR Tools scans live or from a photo and can create a QR for text or a link. File Converter changes an image to JPEG/PNG/WebP, or a video to MP4 or audio-only, without touching the original file.

  • QR scan result checked before you open it; risky links shown as plain text
  • Create QR for text or a link, saved as an image
  • File Converter never overwrites or deletes the source file
STEPS

A step counter, kept on the phone

Steps Today shows the day's count from the phone's own step sensor; Insights looks back over the week and month. Nothing is uploaded.

  • Today's steps, with a daily goal
  • Weekly and monthly history and insights
  • No account, no location, no network needed

Video Player

Library, Continue Watching, subtitles, speed up to 2x, gestures, volume boost, Picture-in-Picture.

Audio Player

Continue Listening, sleep timer that works with the screen off, lock-screen controls.

Image Viewer

3-column library, pinch zoom, rotate (view only), animated GIF/WebP.

Shown above with real device photos: Advanced Compass, File Share Hub, QR Tools, File Converter and Steps. Privacy

What stays on the phone, and what doesn't

On the phone

Browsing history, bookmarks, open tabs, shortcuts, tool history and step totals. Private tabs keep nothing at all.

Never uploaded

Videos, music, photos, PDFs, QR scans, converted files and step totals stay on the device. Websites cannot read your tools.

What it does talk to

Like any browser, it requests the websites you open. It uses Firebase to load its own settings and Google Safe Browsing to check pages.

Honest limits

The Magnetic tool is a sensor reading, not a detector. The Steps tool counts steps only. No VPN is built in.

Questions

Good to know

Do I need an account?

No. You can browse straight away. A Google-account profile is optional and only keeps the account's address as a label.

Where is my data stored?

On your phone: history, bookmarks, open tabs, shortcuts, tool history and step totals. Nothing from the tools is uploaded.

Does it block ads?

It blocks many common ad services, plus YouTube's own ads. It will not catch every ad, and you can allow ads per site.

Is it a security app?

No. Google Safe Browsing warns about unsafe sites through Android; pop-up blocking and Smart Back are conveniences, not malware protection.

Does the Magnetic tool find hidden cameras or metal?

No. It shows the phone's magnetometer reading and says plainly that it is not a metal, camera or radiation detector.

Can I play music with the screen off?

Yes, with lock-screen controls and a sleep timer that works with the screen off.

Can my business get a branded browser or app?

Yes. {{company.name}} builds apps with your name, logo and colour — a browser-mode app with your home page, or a shop app that opens only your website.

Is TMB Brows on the Play Store yet?

Not yet. Use "Request the app" below and we'll be in touch.
